source.adaptation: Eight local review groups cover the upstream ten-item checklist and all additional rules. The upstream does not itself enumerate eight categories. No upstream program or automatic rewriter is executed.

rewrite_procedure.task: Understand the requested scope and evidence; classify the function of each candidate sentence using all six function classes.
Remove only a disclaimer that adds no evidence, scope, logic, conceptual precision or necessary reader guidance; retain all protected facts.
State positive, exact scope when scientifically equivalent; retain a negative boundary if positive wording would obscure validity or safety.
Replace stacked hedging with evidence-bounded precision; keep warranted uncertainty and name its source without increasing causal or statistical force.
Rebuild only the requested paragraph or passage around its main point, one job, logical order and contribution; perform a second self-review and record an itemized revision log.

groups.title: Direct claims and accurate positive scope
semantic_checks: State what is established, examined or proposed; do not imply that a proposed result has been observed.
Determine whether a negative scope boundary is essential to the exact claim; retain it when positive scope would mislead.

groups.title: Precision and warranted uncertainty
semantic_checks: Retain may, suggests, preliminary and under these conditions when justified; never convert association to causation.
Name design, sample, measurement or estimation uncertainty; never insert significant or comprehensive superiority for rhetorical strength.

groups.title: Paragraph purpose and placement
semantic_checks: Use one main job and a clear point per paragraph; assess logic and connection to the main argument.
Place limitations where they change interpretation, usually Methods, Discussion or Limitations; keep qualifiers essential to Abstract or Conclusion sentences.
Repeated limitation statements may be necessary across distinct claims; examine meaning before consolidating.

groups.title: Useful contrast and necessary transitions
semantic_checks: Keep contrasts that distinguish concepts, controls, mechanisms, alternative explanations or reviewer claims.
Remove a transition only when the logical relationship remains explicit and accurate.

groups.title: Necessary clarification and calm authorial posture
semantic_checks: Distinguish useful reader guidance or evidenced rebuttal from pre-emptive negotiation with an imagined critic.
Replace vague modesty or apology with exact contribution and magnitude; preserve small effects and uncertainty.

groups.title: Central contribution and paper coherence
semantic_checks: Identify the main new capability, mechanism, cost reduction or scalability contribution and trace it through Abstract, Introduction, Experiments and Conclusion.
Retain relevant supporting contributions; remove only unrelated presentation within the authorized editing scope.
Narrow or withdraw an unsupported claim rather than adding a generic protective caveat.

groups.title: Experimental purpose, metric tradeoffs and adverse findings
semantic_checks: For each experiment identify effectiveness, mechanism, alternative-explanation or applicability question; identify the exact claim unsupported by a missing experiment.
Report conditions, task, comparison, both improving and worsening metrics, uncertainty and application needs; never change evaluation criteria to avoid an unfavorable result.
Determine whether each adverse result affects the central conclusion; discuss material findings and preserve every registered outcome and failed run.
Do not invent a cause when unknown; do not turn a local weaker metric into an unbounded verdict on the method.
Combine redundant presentation or cross-reference tangential supplement material only using predeclared role/relevance/adequacy, never outcome direction.

groups.title: Review triage, language and example integrity
semantic_checks: Classify review feedback as demonstrated problem, question needing verification or optional additional experiment; change manuscript limitations only when interpretation requires it.
Examples supply wording patterns, never facts, measurements, mechanisms, superiority claims or causal relationships.
Respect requested local scope and draft language; project manuscripts remain English even though Chinese planning text can be inspected.
In the final pass check each changed sentence against evidence and record original/revised text, function, rationale, preserved facts, source locations and unresolved questions.

checklist.text: Repeated statements of what the text does not claim
Negative framing where positive framing would work
Explanations added only to prevent hypothetical misunderstanding
Unnecessary not X but Y structures
Redundant however, nevertheless or although transitions

rules.pattern: \b(?:this (?:paper|study|work) (?:does not claim|is not intended to)|we (?:do not|don't) (?:claim|attempt|intend)|this (?:is not to say|should not be taken to mean))\b|(?:本文|本研究|我们)(?:并不|不)(?:声称|试图|认为)|这(?:并不是说|不应被理解为)
rules.message: A nonclaim may foreground a hypothetical objection.
rules.guidance: Classify its function. State exact scope only if equivalent; retain every necessary validity, ethics or inference boundary.

rules.pattern: \b(?:does not|do not|cannot|can't) (?:fully |completely )?(?:capture|cover|account for|represent|address) (?:all|every|the full|the entire)\b|(?:不能|无法|并不能)(?:完全)?(?:涵盖|覆盖|代表|解释)(?:所有|全部|每个)
rules.message: Negative universal scope may obscure the actual research setting.
rules.guidance: Describe the tested population, period, mechanism or task. Keep a negative boundary when it is necessary to prevent misuse or overgeneralization.

rules.pattern: \b(?:may|might|could|perhaps|possibly|potentially)\s+(?:(?:well|also|in part)\s+)?(?:perhaps|possibly|potentially)\b|(?:可能|或许|也许)(?:在一定程度上)?(?:可能|或许|也许|潜在)|(?:或许|也许)[^。！？\n]{0,35}(?:可能)[^。！？\n]{0,35}(?:潜在|在一定程度上)
rules.message: Stacked hedges make the source and degree of uncertainty unclear.
rules.guidance: Retain scientifically warranted uncertainty, specify its source and improve precision without increasing causal or statistical force.

rules.message: The paragraph opens with a concession before its point.
rules.guidance: Assess the logical job of the concession. Move framing only when the scientific boundary stays next to the qualified claim.

rules.message: A habitual binary may add framing without a useful conceptual distinction.
rules.guidance: Preserve controls, mechanisms and evidenced contrasts. State the precise affirmative contribution when the binary does no analytical work.

rules.pattern: \b(?:however|nevertheless|nonetheless|still)[,;:]?\s+(?:however|nevertheless|nonetheless|still)\b|(?:然而|尽管如此|不过|但是)[，,；;：:]?\s*(?:然而|尽管如此|不过|但是)
rules.message: Stacked transitions repeat a logical relation.
rules.guidance: Keep the transition needed for the argument; do not remove the actual comparison or adverse finding.

rules.pattern: \b(?:to be clear|for (?:the )?avoidance of doubt|it is worth noting that|it should be noted that|to avoid (?:any |potential |possible )?misunderstanding)\b|(?:需要澄清的是|值得注意的是|为避免(?:任何|可能的)?误解|当然这并不意味着)
rules.message: A clarifier may anticipate misunderstanding without adding evidence.
rules.guidance: Review the wrapper only. Keep the following evidence, scope, needed rebuttal or reader guidance intact.

rules.pattern: \b(?:merely|only|simply) (?:attempts?|aims?|seeks?|provides?|offers?)\b|\b(?:modest|limited) contribution\b|\b(?:can only provide limited|leaves much room for improvement)\b|仅仅做了初步尝试|只能提供有限参考|仍有很大提升空间|仅(?:作了|做了)(?:一些|一个)?初步尝试
rules.message: Vague modesty may conceal the exact contribution.
rules.guidance: State what was tested and observed. Preserve genuinely small effects, preliminary status and limited evidence; do not replace modesty with unsupported superiority.

rules.pattern: \b(?:unfortunately|regrettably|admittedly)[,;:]?\s+(?:this|the|our|we)\b|(?:遗憾的是|不得不承认|很遗憾)
rules.message: An apology-like wrapper adds self-assessment to a factual statement.
rules.guidance: State the same facts calmly, retaining unfavorable results, controls, ethics and all interpretation-changing limitations.

rules.pattern: \b(?:the experiments? (?:are|is) insufficient|lower accuracy (?:reveals?|demonstrates?|shows?) (?:the |a )?(?:limitations?|defects?) of (?:the |our )?method)\b|实验(?:仍然|还)?不充分|准确率较低[，,]?(?:说明|表明)(?:该|本|我们的方法)?(?:方法)?(?:仍然|仍)?存在(?:一定)?局限
rules.message: A blanket experiment or method verdict may replace an exact unsupported claim or measured tradeoff.
rules.guidance: Identify the missing experiment and unsupported inference, or report conditions and all relevant metrics. Keep material adverse evidence and narrow any unsupported central conclusion.

rules.pattern: \b(?:unfavorable|negative|null|non[- ]?significant) (?:results?|findings?|experiments?) (?:were|are|have been) (?:omitted|excluded|removed|not reported)\b|(?:删除|省略|不报告|隐去)(?:不利|阴性|负面|不显著)(?:结果|发现|实验)|(?:不利|阴性|负面|不显著)(?:结果|发现|实验)(?:被)?(?:删除|省略|隐去)
rules.message: The text may describe omitting evidence because of its direction.
rules.guidance: Inspect the claim and attribution. Preserve or restore every registered result and failed run; placement must follow predeclared relevance and adequacy, never favorable direction.

rules.pattern: \b(?:to (?:avoid|preempt|pre-empt) (?:possible |potential )?(?:reviewer )?(?:criticism|objections)|reviewers? (?:may|might|could) (?:object|complain))\b|为(?:避免|预防)(?:审稿人)?(?:可能的)?(?:质疑|批评)|审稿人可能会(?:质疑|批评)
rules.message: An imagined reviewer concern may be entering the manuscript as a limitation.
rules.guidance: Separate demonstrated problems, unresolved verification questions and optional experiments. Preserve evidenced rebuttals and interpretation-changing limitations.
